you have covenanted, you shall be filled and clothed with it, and nothing shall hinder you. It is our privilege to have it, and •we shall have it if we will be spirituallyminded, and love to talk of the things of the kingdom, laying aside our light fireside talk, and vanity, and take a course never to grieve the Spirit of God, nor of our brethren. We should be as careful of each other’s feelings…
